title: Cactus rejects hardcore and says goodbye
summary: Cactus Jack mocks the audience’s appetite for violence and presents a safer, corporate future as his escape. His last match puts him opposite the underdog he once mentored.

chapters.title: Cactus stands with Raven
chapters.result: Cactus and Raven lose to Dreamer and Funk.
chapters.context: Cactus’s antagonistic persona puts him against the wrestlers most closely identified with ECW’s loyal crowd.

chapters.title: The final match with Mikey
chapters.show: Big Ass Extreme Bash — night two
chapters.result: Cactus defeats Whipwreck, then gives a farewell.
chapters.context: The departing wrestler sets aside the hostile character for an affectionate final celebration before joining WWE.
